t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit is a versatile drilling solution for trade professionals. This 6mm hex shank drill bit is ideal for plumbers and general builders working on various projects, offering reliable performance across a wide range of building materials. Its robust tungsten-carbide-tipped construction ensures efficient drilling into concrete, brick, roof tiles, ceramics, wood, plastic, and thin metals. The 6mm hex shank provides secure fitting in impact drivers and all 3-jaw chuck tools, including rotary and percussion drills. A white flute aids quick identification, and the 50mm working length allows for precise applications.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
